catalogue_scope: Initial auditable candidate catalogue; not an independently adjudicated gold set. No rules are eligible for final gold scoring yet.

status_definitions.provisional_source_supported: Source supports candidate semantics, but independent reviewer adjudication and external real-data evaluation remain outstanding.
status_definitions.partially_supported: A component of rule is documented; full executable semantics not independently justified.
status_definitions.scope_pending: Potentially correct concept relationship, but context/column availability/semantic scope requires adjudication.
status_definitions.excluded: Known unreliable or unjustified form excluded from reference pool.

entries.semantic_statement: LBDGLUSI is a unit-converted representation of LBXGLU using factor 0.05551; precision is not independently settled.
entries.applicability: Both observations must be present for the same participant.

evidence.supports: CDC explicitly documents multiplier 0.05551 and describes rounding to three decimals.

unresolved: The current three-significant-figure rule was selected on the same GLU_J data; CDC wording states three decimals, so exact precision is not independently established.
An independent dataset/cycle is required before scoring the chosen precision.

entries.semantic_statement: Assets equal total LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity when complete, aligned balance-sheet facts are reported in the same accounting context.
entries.applicability: Same entity, instant reporting date, currency, consolidated accounting scope and filing accession; only if both concepts exist.

evidence.supports: LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity includes the liabilities and all equity, including noncontrolling interests.
Companyfacts facts have taxonomy/tag and units; this does not by itself prove a per-context balance-sheet identity.

unresolved: The right-hand taxonomy concept is not among six summary fields in current SEC metadata; confirm availability in each raw filing.
Implement trustworthy accession/date/unit/scope grouping before evaluation.
Independent accounting adjudication still required; do not infer from LLM proposal.

entries.semantic_statement: Assets = Liabilities + parent-only StockholdersEquity is not a universal consolidated identity.
entries.applicability: Only with separately verified treatment of noncontrolling/redeemable equity; this form is excluded.

evidence.supports: Total liabilities/equity concept includes noncontrolling interests; parent-only equity may omit them.

unresolved: No safe global identity from these three concepts alone.
entries.exclusion_reason: Luna B5 proposal omits context and excludes potential noncontrolling/redeemable equity components.

entries.semantic_statement: If any one of the five mode labels is 1, Machine failure is 1. (One-way implication; converse not imposed.)
entries.applicability: Same AI4I record with all required mode-label fields available; binary labels interpreted as 0/1.

evidence.supports: UCI describes machine failure as set when at least one enumerated failure mode is true, and lists the failure indicators.

unresolved: Dataset is synthetic and has already been explored in development; not an untouched external test.
Independently check label semantics with a second reviewer and verify source version.

entries.semantic_statement: For flows containing at least one forward packet, forward packet minimum <= mean <= maximum.
entries.applicability: Positive forward packet count and finite, matched packet-length statistics for the same flow; skip zero-packet flows.

evidence.supports: CICFlowMeter describes minimum, maximum and mean packet length for the forward direction.
Flow feature generation computes forward min/mean/max from the same forward-packet statistics.
